results.author: A 🖤
results.text: All 4 kids have gift exchanges in their classes and the teachers requested we send little gifts for their “stockings” for 23-26 students. Times that by 4, that’s roughly $120-$140 and that’s if I go to the dollar tree. Everything isn’t even $1 anymore there. 😅😅😅😅😅😅😅🙃

results.author: Jenny
results.text: Teachers…I’m a little confused. I see people asking for big Christmas gifts for their students like $20 Squishmallows, books, Lego sets, etc. Do you really spend $20 - $30 a student for Christmas? (Or ask donors to?) That seems like so much to me! Is that normal?
